title: Tween: motionSnap not in tween inspector and not applied in getTweenedFrame
description: The motionSnap field is decoded from FLA binary (flash8-binary.ts line 2549) but: (1) the tween inspector in Timeline.tsx (line 1963) has no Snap checkbox, and (2) getTweenedFrame in timeline-query.ts (line 229) ignores it. Fix: (1) add a Snap checkbox to the tween inspector that toggles kf.motionSnap, (2) in getTweenedFrame when traversing a motion guide path, if motionSnap=true clamp t to exactly 0.0 at the start frame and 1.0 at the end frame of the span.
